terms.guidance: Contextual rendering within the 71.2 female honorific list. Source 国君 retained; not a silent Chinese correction to 郡君 or a claim that sovereign rulers attended. A more specific title would require further textual support.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.guidance: Move from public ceremony to intimate disclosure without becoming an all-knowing explanatory commentator. Translate explicitly narrated motives, folly and social judgments, including discomforting gendered generalizations, while preserving reported claims as speech. Keep scene transitions and suspended chapter endings.
voices.avoid: Do not erase source psychology under a general ban on interpretation; do not add motives, future outcomes or modern diagnoses.

voices.speaker: Grandmother Jia
voices.guidance: Affection and domestic wit coexist with uncompromising authority. Her defence of Xi-feng and poor visiting girls is concrete; gambling punishment is severe. At dinner she relaxes service rules for her own pleasure; at moon-viewing she enjoys family jokes but feels the partiality jibe.
voices.avoid: No uniformly cuddly grandmother; no omniscience about secret disputes before she is told.

voices.speaker: Xi-feng
voices.guidance: Let outward courtesy, humiliation, proud defensiveness and physical exhaustion coexist. Her five-part defence needs a sustained logical rhythm. Jokes about money and the letter can cut; gratitude and tears are not all a single cynical mask.
voices.avoid: Do not compress long defence, replace hypothetical suspects with proven culprits, or make her a cheerful modern administrator.

voices.speaker: Patience
voices.guidance: Private frankness about illness, practical intervention and tactful concealment are different modes. She is modest toward the girls but authoritative toward servants. She protects reputations while arranging a specific remedy.
voices.avoid: Do not turn tact into lying everywhere, certify her leak hypothesis or make her proposed money share a fee to Faithful.

voices.speaker: Faithful
voices.guidance: Her access to Grandmother gives her authority, but she remains a servant. Shock at Chess’s secret gives way to empathy, an oath and admonition. Her joking with Jia Lian is guarded; her rice complaint is dry, domestic wit.
voices.avoid: No moral prosecutor of Chess, no romance with Jia Lian inferred from loan help, no later84 fate imported.

voices.speaker: Lady Xing
voices.guidance: Public charitable phrasing masks a challenge to Xi-feng; private criticism of Ying-chun is resentful and hierarchical. Her threat to Simpleton is blunt. Keep the stepmother relationship and grievance about the elder branch.
voices.avoid: Do not make her the biological mother of Ying-chun or certify every accusation her servants feed her.

voices.speaker: Lady Wang
voices.guidance: Shame, anger, piety and solicitous concern for the girls coexist. Her sudden hostility to Skybright is explicitly tied to appearance, recollection and denunciation. Her defence of the girls’ small staffs opposes Xi-feng’s economy proposal.
voices.avoid: Do not soften threats into mild advice, or turn the narrative description of unmasked emotion into an invented diagnosis.

voices.speaker: You-shi
voices.guidance: Ceremonial competence, hunger, offended dignity, accommodation to servants and coarse private disgust vary by company. Her quarrel with Xi-chun moves from explanation and defence of Picture to wounded sarcasm and anger.
voices.avoid: No generic timid or merely indecent caricature; do not make her certify the Zhen visitors’ business or the gambling claims.

voices.speaker: Tan-chun
voices.guidance: Precise, strategic and increasingly angry. She links an affront to one sister to all their standing, summons help silently, then insists a search be acknowledged in words. The slap follows unwanted handling of her clothes. Her tears at internal collapse are not ornamental.
voices.avoid: Do not anticipate a later political role or turn her speech into a modern manifesto; do not invert the slap sequence.

voices.speaker: Ying-chun
voices.guidance: Pauses, lowered eyes, repeated appeals to let matters rest and retreat into reading should feel evasive and gentle without deleting her specific reasoning. She refuses to intercede when the others already failed and says she cannot deceive the seniors indefinitely.
voices.avoid: Do not reduce every response to stupidity or invent consent to the theft.

voices.speaker: Xi-chun
voices.guidance: Fright during the search hardens into insistence on detachment. Preserve repetitive refusal, moral quotations and her refusal to be implicated in Ning gossip. You-shi’s sarcasm and Picture’s pleas should press against that cold resolve.
voices.avoid: No premature completed conversion or sainthood from85; no endorsement that harshness is spiritually correct.

voices.speaker: Bao-yu
voices.guidance: Affection for the girls, anxiety before his father, selective literary enthusiasm, fear of examination and willingness to accept the sham illness all belong here. At the feast he weighs opposite risks of telling a joke.
voices.avoid: Do not import81’s later grief or make him wholly ignorant of books; do not erase narrator’s explicit calculations.

voices.speaker: Aroma and Musk
voices.guidance: Aroma placates an insulted mistress and later firmly tells Bao-yu to concentrate; Musk redirects his concern for her clothes back to his books. Their practical care is affectionate but not sugary.
voices.avoid: Do not merge their speeches or make every line an expression of jealousy.

voices.speaker: Skybright
voices.guidance: Sharp to sleepy juniors, resourceful in the fright deception, constrained before Lady Wang, and explosively dignified at the search. Her tears and strategic defence need their own rhythms.
voices.avoid: Do not make the search prove sexual guilt, make the false sighting true, or sanitize her harshness toward juniors.

voices.speaker: Chess and Pan You-an
voices.guidance: Chess’s terror, gratitude, anger at abandonment and later unashamed silence differ by scene. The letter is intimate but conventionally respectful; repeat its urgency and preserve the deferential signature. Pan is unnamed until the letter.
voices.avoid: Do not fill in sexual actions or future outcome. Do not translate cousin as biological brother.

voices.speaker: Cai-xia, her mother and Wang-er’s wife
voices.guidance: Wang-er’s wife flatters upward and disparages the parents; the mother agrees under pressure; Cai-xia separately fears the match. These voices must not collapse into mutual acceptance.
voices.avoid: No happy arranged-wedding scene; no Cai-yun substitution; no husband substituted for the solicitor.

voices.speaker: Jia Lian and Lin Zhi-xiao
voices.guidance: Jia Lian’s exaggerated courtesy solicits help; his joking, anxiety and shifts over the marriage show compromise. Lin’s warning about the son is tactful but concrete. The proposed estate reductions remain discussion.
voices.avoid: Do not make the report of Yu-cun’s demotion certain or all proposed punishments enacted.

voices.speaker: Mrs Wang Shan-bao and Zhou Rui’s wife
voices.guidance: Both exploit hierarchy and information, but at the search one is humiliated while the other joins the mocking chorus. Titles of respect can become barbs. Preserve the different roles and knowledge.
voices.avoid: No merged generic old woman, no modern neutral investigator, no proof from accusation alone.

voices.speaker: Jia Zheng and Jia She
voices.guidance: Jia Zheng awkwardly performs humour for his mother, then reasserts standards over poetry. Jia She’s joke suggests partiality and provokes a retreat; his praise of Jia Huan has a privileged, boastful ease.
voices.avoid: Do not treat either joke as autobiography or medical truth, or the inheritance boast as a legal transfer.

voices.speaker: Xing De-quan, Xue Pan and the boy favourites
voices.guidance: Drunken self-pity and coarse privilege dominate; the two boys use a rehearsed, economically dependent performance to soothe patrons. Render the source’s exploitation without voyeurism.
voices.avoid: No erotic expansion, invented consent, or added sexual action. Ages stay as stated; paid compliance is not free affection.

scenes.event: 贾政回京，诸事完毕，赐假一月在家歇息，读书、与清客下棋饮酒、和家人团聚。
scenes.voice: 叙述者平实交代官差与家庭节奏。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 不把一个月写成告老或终身闲居。
scenes.englishExecution: One month’s leave and family relaxation, not retirement.

scenes.event: 贾母寿宴分日举行；府门、宾客品级、男女分席、献礼、女孩见客与后续宴客。
scenes.voice: 公开仪典与私下亲昵并存；贾母让贵客，众女依次应酬。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 贵客次序、五女孩名单及各人礼物依源，勿自动补上迎春；八十寿不与其他回年龄强行统一。
scenes.englishExecution: Ranked birthday ritual; preserve guest days, gift units, five girls and deliberate absence of Ying-chun.

scenes.event: 尤氏来时未吃饭；园门与婆子失礼引起争执，袭人等中间劝解。
scenes.voice: 尤氏受辱而含怒，婆子倚势顶嘴；袭人顾体面。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 分别保留原来吩咐与周瑞家后来转述，不认定同一即时处置。
scenes.englishExecution: You-shi’s hunger, unlocked gates and insults; differentiate the maid’s anger, Aroma’s tact and the nuns’ placation.

scenes.event: 周瑞家的传话变重，引来捆人；尤氏说情，凤姐另有自己的安排。
scenes.voice: 奴仆利用信息差，凤姐以家政秩序处理。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 传话人的夸张不是凤姐逐字原令。
scenes.englishExecution: Zhou Rui’s wife accelerates the punishment beyond Xi-feng’s stated timetable; You-shi tries to let it go.

scenes.event: 赵姨娘打探；林之孝家的指点两小丫头，其中一人告诉姐姐并和费婆子说了，费婆子再向邢夫人求情，邢夫人不满积聚。
scenes.voice: 窃语、讨情、阶层算计，不能都写成中性报告。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 费婆子话中夸张与作者事实层分开。
scenes.englishExecution: Mrs Lin advises children; one tells her sister and Mrs Fei; Mrs Fei petitions Lady Xing. No direct Lin–Fei conversation.

scenes.event: 宗族家宴，喜鸾、四姐儿获贾母喜欢；邢夫人当众责凤姐，王夫人放人，凤姐私下流泪。
scenes.voice: 邢夫人表面慈宽与公开施压；凤姐忍住而不当席爆发。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 贾㻞字形保留；两女孩宗族关系不补成近姊妹。
scenes.englishExecution: Clan gathering and public humiliation; Xi-feng replies then weeps privately. No newly invented kinship.

scenes.event: 凤姐报告寿屏，贾母选留甄家和邬家两架备将来送人；鸳鸯知道凤姐委屈原委，贾母维护凤姐。
scenes.voice: 鸳鸯熟悉内情但恪守主仆语气，贾母心疼孙媳。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 屏风材料、供者、架数与扇数分开；只留待送人，不写已送出。不写贾母早知争执全部经过。
scenes.englishExecution: Screens remain reserved, not delivered; Faithful learns the cause before informing Grandmother.

scenes.event: 贾母关照贫亲与孩子，宝玉和探春说笑，喜鸾婚嫁谈论。
scenes.voice: 贾母的慈爱带家长权威；宝玉借玩笑显感伤。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 不要把闲谈未来当既定婚约或作者预测。
scenes.englishExecution: Poor visiting girls, servants’ snobbery, Tan-chun’s worries and Bao-yu’s fatalistic joking; no betrothal.

scenes.event: 鸳鸯夜遇私会，先以为两个女孩，见到男子才明白；司棋求保密。
scenes.voice: 鸳鸯惊讶后转为怜惜；司棋惧祸而求告。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 男子此时没有潘又安之名；不提前以74回信件暴露身份，也不补性行为。
scenes.englishExecution: Faithful moves from mistaken playful interpretation to recognition. The cousin remains unnamed.

scenes.event: 司棋害怕秘密泄露，姑表兄弟逃走，病中获鸳鸯安慰与保密誓语。
scenes.voice: 司棋羞惧、怨薄情；鸳鸯以处境相惜而非主审。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 亲属称呼依叙述/对白；不从后文反推此处已死亡或成婚。
scenes.englishExecution: Interrupted private meeting, flight, fear, illness and promise of secrecy. No consummation or later death imported.

scenes.event: 平儿向鸳鸯说明凤姐月事淋漓已一月，劝其休养。
scenes.voice: 贴身人的关切与隐瞒家务压力。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 人物医理是时代说法，不替她诊断现代病名。
scenes.englishExecution: Month-long menstrual bleeding and embarrassment; distinguish observed symptom from lay interpretation.

scenes.event: 说官媒与孙家婚事，贾琏向鸳鸯试探借老太太金银器皿典当。
scenes.voice: 贾琏赔笑求助，鸳鸯以熟人分寸调侃而谨慎。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 媒亲尚未点名女方；借物处于计划/交涉，不写已经抵押。油冻佛手不是食品。
scenes.englishExecution: Official matchmaker, stone ornament inventory and proposed pawn of a chest; no bride named or pawn completed here.

scenes.event: 贾琏求凤姐说服鸳鸯，提出谢礼，平儿建议拿一二百；继而谈尤二姐周年、钱粮紧张及旧花销。
scenes.voice: 贾琏的感伤与凤姐的反击相撞。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 周年与前后年序若不合须保留，不擅改半年或年份。
scenes.englishExecution: Jia Lian asks Xi-feng’s help; Patience’s suggested share is for Xi-feng; anniversary wording retained.

scenes.event: 旺儿媳妇求为十七岁的儿子娶彩霞，凤姐施压；家计与月钱讨论。
scenes.voice: 强势包办与财务抱怨，彩霞没有在场自由应允。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 彩霞与彩云分别；数字为人物陈述，不全充账簿定额。
scenes.englishExecution: Wang-er’s WIFE solicits the match; her assurance about the girl is not consent. Financial complaints remain speech.

scenes.event: 凤姐讲百匹缎子梦；夏太监遣小内监来借二百，旧账一千二百未还，项圈典四百分两用。
scenes.voice: 梦中恐惧与现实敲索互映；夫妻盘算。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 梦里娘娘身份未定；梦物不算实物收入。典当与后续二百的归属须分层。
scenes.englishExecution: Unidentified dream lady, eunuch’s demands and actual400 pawn split200/200; separate old1200 debt.

scenes.event: 雨村消息，精减丫头的建议；林之孝说明旺儿子酗酒赌博，彩霞父母受压。
scenes.voice: 林之孝委婉警告；凤姐强行担保。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 谣传未证实，裁人尚建议；父母应承不可渲染为婚姻自愿。
scenes.englishExecution: Yu-cun rumour, proposed staff reductions, Lin’s warning and mother’s coerced compliance; no actual dismissal list.

scenes.event: 彩霞怕旺儿强求成婚，遣妹小霞向赵姨娘问讯；贾环不甚在意，赵姨娘转求贾政；贾政说未来安排丫头，末尾突响。
scenes.voice: 彩霞绝望、贾环薄情、赵姨娘试探。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 贾政只是未来安排；73开头才揭响声，不在72收尾先解释。
scenes.englishExecution: Cai-xia sends Xiao-xia, Aunt Zhao appeals, Jia Zheng plans future arrangements; noise remains unexplained.

scenes.event: 上回赵姨娘与贾政说话间突响，原是窗屉扣件脱落；随后小鹊到怡红院给宝玉报信。
scenes.voice: 日常事故先解上回悬念；小鹊另到怡红院，宝玉听风声将受盘问。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 两处场景与先后顺序不混。小鹊只用这般如此概括，不替源文补其逐字转述。
scenes.englishExecution: Fallen window fastening first; Xiao-que’s later warning is a second scene and only summarized.

scenes.event: 宝玉盘算所学并连夜背书，丫鬟困倦，晴雯训人，袭人麝月催专心。
scenes.voice: 内心焦虑、厌八股与对丫鬟的体贴并行。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 区分能背、有半生、偶读和未读，不能统写不识书；谷粱保源。
scenes.englishExecution: Examination anxiety with precise degrees of knowledge; maids’ fatigue, sharpness and practical care.

scenes.event: 金星玻璃称有人跳墙，晴雯借机叫宝玉装病，晴雯与玻璃取药并闹开。
scenes.voice: 晴雯主动编说亲见以脱考试难。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 金星玻璃是一人，玻璃不是59回贾母的同名丫头；入侵未查实；补晴只修姓名。
scenes.englishExecution: Gold-flecked Glass is Parfumée; Skybright devises the sham illness; no intruder confirmed.

scenes.event: 探春陈说赌博，贾母追究，查出三大头家八小头家二十多人，惩处乳母等。
scenes.voice: 贾母的防乱理由包含园中女眷名声；探春先以日常小赌估量。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 被查首领和亲戚关系准确；不可把全部二十多人说成首领。
scenes.englishExecution: Keep gambling counts, actual punishments and Grandmother’s reasoning about reputation and access.

scenes.event: 傻大姐拾绣春囊，不懂所画；邢夫人收走并保密。
scenes.voice: 幼稚笑语与成人震惊对照。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 不明说物主；图文只有源文呈现的范围，不造露骨绣字。
scenes.englishExecution: Simpleton misunderstands the erotic object; Lady Xing threatens secrecy. No owner identified.

scenes.event: 邢夫人责迎春，强调家庭亲疏，仆人插话。
scenes.voice: 迎春顺从，邢夫人嫌其无用又争大房体面。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 邢夫人无出，迎春为庶出，不写为亲生；迎春与贾琏同父异母。
scenes.englishExecution: Lady Xing’s stepmother status and household grievance; Ying-chun and Jia Lian have different mothers.

scenes.event: 迎春金凤被乳母私典，绣桔要追究，乳嫂反来要挟，迎春看感应篇躲避。
scenes.voice: 绣桔急直，乳嫂无理算账，迎春求息。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 三十两等为争执中的声称，非核实债务；白填了限不猜改眼。
scenes.englishExecution: The wet-nurse’s daughter-in-law admits pawning then claims disputed expenses. Redemption is not conditional justice.

scenes.event: 探春介入，侍书私请平儿，平儿以管家语言质问奶嫂。
scenes.voice: 探春把受辱提升到姊妹共同尊严，平儿谦称却有执行力。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 保密召人是谁安排必须清楚；齿竭唇亡保源不换成常见成语。
scenes.englishExecution: Tan-chun’s silent signal brings Scribe’s errand and Patience’s intervention. Preserve rank and indirect attack.

scenes.event: 迎春仍求息，黛玉讽刺只谈因果，门外来人。
scenes.voice: 黛玉读书人的尖利与迎春的退缩。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 本回结尾不提前点明74开头来人为宝玉。
scenes.englishExecution: Ying-chun continues reading and wants peace; Dai-yu’s irony is not the narrator’s verdict. Next visitor unnamed.

scenes.event: 宝玉来替柳家求情；平儿隐瞒金凤纠纷，只给王住儿媳妇补救期限。
scenes.voice: 宝玉怜惜、平儿遮掩迎春体面。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 只说限定追回，未叙金凤归还。
scenes.englishExecution: Bao-yu’s petition motive; Patience gives a deadline but no recovered phoenix is narrated.

scenes.event: 贾琏向凤姐转述邢夫人索二百两，二人疑典老太太器物之事泄露；凤姐另典金项圈二百应付。平儿说明借老太太器物经贾母私下允许。
scenes.voice: 凤姐疑泄密而烦，平儿辨清借款流向。
scenes.knowledgeAndRelationshipBoundary: 72回两项圈典四百分作两笔二百；74回另典二百，贾琏要多典二百被拒。两回不是同一四百交易。谁泄密仍未查实；本回贾母私允信息不提前写进72。
scenes.englishExecution: Another200 pawn, refused extra200, unproved leak and newly disclosed private consent for vessels.

relationships.guidance: Jia She fathers Ying-chun and Jia Lian by different mothers. Lady Xing has no biological children in her statement and is Ying-chun’s stepmother. Lady Wang belongs to Jia Zheng’s branch. Do not change these to smooth jealous comparisons.

You-shi is Jia Zhen’s wife, the wife of Jia Rong’s father, and Xi-chun’s sister-in-law. Her treatment of Jia Rong’s wife as daughter-in-law is not evidence that she bore Jia Rong. Pei-feng is Jia Zhen’s concubine, not You-shi’s sexual partner despite her possessive household wording.

Wang Shan-bao and his wife are Chess’s maternal grandparents. Chess’s paternal aunt married a Pan; Pan You-an is therefore her paternal-aunt’s son. Preserve local姑舅/姑表 wording without implying literal siblings. Xi-feng’s surname puzzle is teasing, not a genealogical proof. Do not derive the aunt from Mrs Wang’s own daughter.

Initially thinks Chess is hiding playfully; then glimpses a male. Promise and later reassurance precede the raid. Do not have her inform the authorities or narrate that her silence failed by betrayal.

The wife solicits, the husband is discussed, son17 is the proposed bridegroom. Cai-xia’s mother’s words are compelled; Xi-feng’s delighted-agreement report is contradicted by narration. Jia Huan has not promised marriage.

Her parents are in the south, she and brother depend on uncle/aunt; brother serves Ning and deposits his rewards. She serves Xi-chun while calling You-shi our mistress. Do not impose a modern employment contract or make You-shi her mother.

Wet-nurse took ornament; her daughter-in-law Wang Zhu-er’s wife argues the account. Chess and Xiu-ju defend Ying-chun. Patience negotiates a remedy, not verified repayment. Distinct from Mrs Wang Shan-bao.

Aunt Zhao gives Mrs Lin a hostile reading of events; Mrs Lin directs the young petitioners to family connections; one child approaches sister and Mrs Fei; Mrs Fei appeals to Lady Xing. Preserve all intervening links.

Jia Lian calls Faithful sister while seeking her help, not because she is his sibling. You-shi calls Zhou Rui’s wife sister; Patience respectfully addresses Tan-chun while commanding lower servants. Do not standardize all姐姐as biological sister.

Grandmother’s vessels, Xi-feng’s neck-rings and reported dowry/private wealth are distinct pools. Patience’s revelation of prior private consent occurs only in74; suspicion of a leak remains unsolved. No affair between Faithful and Jia Lian is established.

Erotic scent-bag owner remains unknown. Pan’s two received scent-bags are not found in Chess’s chest; complete own82.60 confirms continuity but is not imported into earlier narration. Letter and seized footwear are separate evidence.
Mrs Wang Shan-bao’s denunciation, Lady Wang’s memory, Xi-feng’s limited assent, Skybright’s defence and empty search are distinct evidentiary levels. No narrator-certified seduction or bag ownership.

Bao-chai is exempt as guest. Nightingale’s objects are Bao-yu’s old things. Tan-chun protects her maids while opening her own possessions. Li Wan sleeps; no search finding turns any girl into a convicted adulterer.

Prince of Nan’an, his dowager, Prince of Beijing and his consort are distinct persons. Marquis of Jinxiang/Earl of Linchang followed by诰命 denotes their titled wives. Do not turn female seats into seats occupied by men.

Shared compounds can omit a repeated家的, as林之孝赖大家的. Resolve the coordinated female referents, not two male stewards. A relative’s name inside an identifying phrase does not place that relative in the scene.

Xi-luan is a daughter of Jia Bin’s mother; Si-jie of Jia Qiong’s mother. This establishes sibling relation to those named men but not an unmentioned father. Si-jie is not Si-er or Xi-chun. Poor clan kin are not visiting foreign nobles.
Simpleton is the finder; her mother is the laundry visitor suspected of passing information. They are separate people. The suspicion is not proved and the girl’s nickname is not a medical diagnosis.

Zhen case reported; visitors’ purpose unknown. Bao-chai states maternal illness and temporary intention to return. Looks exchanged by others leave implication open; do not declare she already knows or intends all later outcomes.

Two16/17-year-old boy favourites serve wine under patron power; under15 household attendants form another group. Flattery is trained behaviour in dependency. No new sexual action, consent inference or adult-age substitution.

Bao-yu/Jia Lan/Jia Huan compose separately; none of their actual poem texts is supplied. Jia Zheng reads, Grandmother responds, Jia She praises Huan and boasts of inheritance. No guaranteed office follows.
